notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes: - Fixed a hint that did not redirect to the right cat.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
- Synchronized the cat name notifications to when you click them so the cat's name you see is the one you clicked. Some people were just too good at the game and clicked the cats so fast, there would be a queue and names would become desynchronized.

- Added a description of how hints work in timed mode. The hints become not random anymore when you play timed mode to allow people to make consistent routes when planning.
